exercises.prompt: Select the correct Form V maṣdar of تَعَلَّمَ ('learning').
exercises.explanation: Form V maṣādir follow تَفَعُّلٌ with a ḍammah before the final radical: تَعَلُّمٌ.

feedback.rule: Form V maṣdar: تَفَعُّلٌ (tafaʿʿul); Form VI maṣdar: تَفَاعُلٌ (tafāʿul).

exercises.prompt: Which semantic nuance is characteristic of Form VI (تَفَاعَلَ, e.g., تَعَاوَنَ)?
choices: Mutual or reciprocal action among multiple participants
Causing someone else to perform an action
exercises.answer: Mutual or reciprocal action among multiple participants
exercises.explanation: Form VI typically expresses reciprocal action (e.g., تَعَاوَنَ 'to cooperate with one another').

feedback.rule: Form VI = reciprocal / mutual counterpart of Form III.
